notes.title: Release Into 1.0
notes.notes: The game has now released into 1.0 however, please note that the game state has not changed.

notes.title: Update Notes 4/11/21
notes.notes:
-Improved Omaha AI
-Added new melee weapon to Castle Itter
-Fixed Itter sky Issue
-Improved visuals on Omaha
-Improved visuals on Hurtgen
-Fixed hit indicator bug

notes.title: Demo Update #2
notes.notes:
New Version of Dunkirk Added:

Added more cover for players
New third lane for enemies added closer to preexisting lanes. Makes combat more concentrated.
Additional details added  

The original version of Dunkirk is still available for those who want to test.


Weapons:
M1911 has been buffed
Lewis' sights have been adjusted for increased accuracy
Trench gun has been buffed
Voice lines for grenade throw have been added
